_meta.source: Copied verbatim from index.html (EN) and es/index.html (ES), live site 2026-11-21.
notes: Category grouping is a PROPOSAL for layout, not confirmed by Melanie.
silk-press-trim: homepage says $100+, /links/ says $100. Using $100+ until confirmed.
No color services are listed on the current site; none are added here until Melanie provides them.
Category names (EN/ES) are new layout proposals; all service names/descriptions are verbatim.

description.en: Shape and balance tailored to your curls. Curly cut on dry hair—wash and styling not included.
description.es: Forma y equilibrio para tus rizos. Corte en pelo seco—sin lavado ni peinado incluido.

description.en: Curly cut with wash, deep hydration, curl-defining products, and diffused drying.
description.es: Corte con lavado, hidratación, productos para definir rizos y secado con difusor.

description.en: Smoothing service for natural hair—a silky, straight finish without relaxers. Includes shampoo, blow-dry, trim, and flat iron for shine and movement.
description.es: Alisado suave para pelo natural—acabado lacio y brillante sin relajante químico. Incluye champú, secado, recorte y plancha.

description.en: Relaxer service to soften and straighten hair, calm frizz, and leave hair smooth, shiny, and manageable.
description.es: Servicio de relajante para alisar, calmar el frizz y dejar el pelo manejable y con brillo.

description.en: Precision haircut for curly, wavy, or straight hair. Wash and styling not included.
description.es: Corte de precisión para pelo rizado, ondulado o lacio. Sin lavado ni peinado incluido.

description.en: Targeted cleansing: hydrating, repairing, clarifying, or balancing for oilier scalps.
description.es: Lavado según tu necesidad: hidratación, reparación, purificación o equilibrio.
